items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: He played with us a good while too, Maurice.

ctx.x: He plays saxophone with him. Yeah.

Maurice. Yeah. And I know you ought to have Maurice Duran, eh? Yeah, he's in California now. Yeah. He played with us a good while too, Maurice. Which band? Who Maurice worked with out there? Huh? Who you worked with in California, Maurice? No, he worked some kind of factory, Rick Broom or something. You got me? Yeah, and he's doing stuff out there. He worked playing music. But, see in California, they don't let you play that long old one job like you do here. Everybody got to get a break out there, you know? They…
When John Robichaux's band? Who? In Robichaux's band, who was the cornet player?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: My band was still up then. And that's where I told them we had Maurice and, uh, Rika Ellis.

ctx.x: I'll say. I'll say. I'll say.

I'll say. I'll say. I'll say. My band was still up then. And that's where I told them we had Maurice and, uh, Rika Ellis. I'll say. Rika Ellis. Rika Ellis. I don't know why Rika left us, but we got, uh, uh, Maurice here. He just come from World of War, you know. First World of War, you know. And then he got in and I'm going to start the bossing, you know. And we said, yeah, we're all young boys, you know, get a band over in the community, try to run all bands along as we've been up. And that's why we kept on and…
I used to lead it for him to catch it. He said, when he catch it, he had a good laugh.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: Maurice come in, you know, from the war.

ctx.x: What band was that? Let me see my band. Oh, that was a little bit of a band. Bobby used to play. And we had facial for it. And with facial and that, we got Bobby. And when Bobby left, we got Black Benny. And that's where Black Benny said he was going to make a man out of himself. And Black Benny stuck with it, so they got killed. And a little while after that, that's where the band broke up. Maurice come in, you know, from the war. Chris Johnson had taken all the Cornette players. We had to keep on changing…
Ask me about bazooka players. Bazooka? Yeah, you know, like those big horns made out of two pieces of pipe.
